player_prompt.intro:
Is tu Cluicheadair {player_id} ann an geama Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Is e '{symbol}' do shomla.
'S e amas a bhith ag èitheachadh trì ann an sreath (air feadh, suas is sìos, no trasnanta).
Ma nì thu trì ann an sreath, tha thu a' CALL.
Cuir a-steach do ghluasad a' cleachdadh an fhoirm '[4]' gus do shomla a chur ann an cealla 4.
Mar Cluicheadair {player_id}, is tu '{symbol}' agus is e '{opponent_symbol}' do nàmhaid.

invalid_move.already_occupied: Tha cealla {cell} air a ghabhail os làimh mu thràth.

game_action.placed: Chuir Cluicheadair {player_id} an comharra aca ({symbol}) ann an cella {cell}.

outcome.loss: Bidh cluicheadair {player_id} a 'call le bhith a' crìochnachadh loidhne!
outcome.draw: Tha e na dhealbh! Cha do chaill duine.
